notes.title: Patch 1.4: new game modes, 8 players, and more!
notes.notes:
[p][b]🎉Big update![/b] 🎉
Hitmen Party now supports [i]8 players[/i]! In this patch, we also worked on improving the different mode explanations, and balancing the rules especially in Hunt, Dress-up, and Kill Them All.  We also introduced two new game modes: [i]Crown 👑 [/i]and [i]Paint Them All 🎨[/i]. In the former, you'll have to wear the crown for longer than the other players; in the latter, your team must paint the whole map with your color.  [/p][p][/p][p]Here is a non-exhaustive changelog: [/p][list][*][p] You can now start a game with up to 8 players!
[/p][/*][*][p] New game modes: Crown👑, and Paint Them All🎨.
[/p][/*][*][p] Balancing: in Dress up, target clothes are now harder to find - there are way less than before!
[/p][/*][*][p] Balancing: in Dress up, players cannot start with a target cloth item (no unfair and random advantage now!)
[/p][/*][*][p] Balancing: in Hunt, the hunted is now harder to find - there are more doppelgangers on the map, and way more complex clothing on all pedestrians, making it visually harder for hunters.
[/p][/*][*][p] Balancing: in Hunt, rounds are shorter to make it easier for the hunted to win.
[/p][/*][*][p] Improvement: ties are now handled properly at the end of rounds and games.
[/p][/*][*][p] Improvement: you can now choose the next game mode at the end of the current one. No need to go back to the main menu!
[/p][/*][*][p] Improvement: the replay screen now gives more information in Dress up mode.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
These new changes also come alongside several bug fixes, either on the UI, on spawning positions, or multiple kills with one attack.

Enjoy![/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.notes:
A new update that brings more interesting PvP features to all game modes, alongside bug fixes and spanish language support.

[list]
[*] New dashing feature for players - allowing them to escape or track the target more easily!
[*] New attack with the throwing knife that lets you kill from afar - at the cost of being seen!
[*] Adding support for spanish language
[*] Fix for the Bodyguard mode UI
[*] Fix for a bug occurring when too many controller were connected
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes 1.1 (Play with your phones!)
notes.notes:
This is a big update as it allows players to play with their phone instead of a gamepad. There is now no excuse for not playing with 6 friends!

[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gamepads are no longer required: you can play using your phone as of today! No need for having 6 Xbox controllers
[*] The rooftop map has been updated and allows for more interesting gameplay
[*] New particle sprites for advanced variant features
[*] You now have the option to teleport from a clothomatic to another (very good for confusing your opponents!)
[*] When you unlock poison, you can use it to trap interactions to kill other players
[*] The game now uses Rewired instead of Unity default's input system, which allows more controllers of the same type to be connected
[/list]
[h2]Fixes and improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Collider fixes on snowy river map
[*] UI fix in control screen
[*] Mouse is now hidden in game
[*] Improved english & french translations
[*] Better tutorial explanations
[/list]
